name: studio-toolbelt
description: The exact tool roster provisioned on a studio machine: modern CLI replacements (fd, ripgrep, tgrep, eza, bat, sd, dust, zoxide, difftastic), AI tooling (rtk, qmd, ollama, skills), dev apps and services (gh, lazygit, docker/orbstack, linear, notion). Activates at the start of shell work, when searching or listing files, processing text, diffing, or checking whether a tool or capability is available on this machine.
